content.title: Cancellations or Significant Delays | Southwest Airlines
content.text: We know that airline-imposed delays, cancellations, and schedule changes can have an impact on an important moment in your life. We appreciate your understanding during situations like this. Our goal is to equip you with options when things don’t go as planned. Traveling on an itinerary involving a partner airline? Review important details.Flight delaysYou are eligible for a refund if your flight is significantly delayed (generally a delay of three or more hours domestically and six or more hours internationally) and you decide not to travel. See details about your available options. Please cancel your reservation at least 10 minutes before the new flight's scheduled departure time in accordance with our no-show policy. If your new itinerary doesn’t work, you can rebook your flight.If you decide not to travel and you are not eligible for a refund because the delay is not significant, you must cancel your reservation at least 10 minutes before the new flight's scheduled departure time in accordance with our no-show policy.Getaways by Southwest™ Customers: review your options.Flight cancellationsIf your flight has been canceled and you decide not to travel, you are eligible for a refund. See details about your available options. Please cancel your reservation at least 10 minutes before the new flight's scheduled departure time in accordance with our no-show policy..If your new itinerary doesn’t work, you can rebook your flight.Getaways by Southwest™ Customers: review your options.Schedule changes (8+ days prior to scheduled departure)You are eligible for a refund if the change to your itinerary is significant (generally resulting in a delay of three or more hours domestically and six or more hours internationally) and you decide not to travel. See details about your available options. Please cancel your reservation at least 10 minutes before the new flight's scheduled departure time in accordance with our no-show policy.If your new itinerary doesn’t work, you can rebook your flight.If you decide not to travel and you are not eligible for a refund because the change is not significant, you must cancel your reservation at least 10 minutes before the new flight's scheduled departure time in accordance with our no-show policy.Getaways by Southwest™ Customers: review your options.
